# BC Lake Monitoring Network Summary Reports

This project repository includes code to pull lake water quality data from 
the [BC Environmental Monitoring Data System](https://www2.gov.bc.ca/gov/content?id=BDE7F9F4BC4546629582CEBC4ABC8101) accessed via the publicly available [EnMoDS Web Reporting](https://enmodswr.nrs.gov.bc.ca/) tool.

Observational data is collected as part of the [BC Lake Monitoring Network](https://www2.gov.bc.ca/gov/content?id=2493EFF1E42747E1904540DA4D2CF9DD). Output reports are shared with the public via the website and are linked to the [BC Lake Monitoring Networks Interactive Map](https://governmentofbc.maps.arcgis.com/apps/webappviewer/index.html?id=dc3a3c7341ed4aafb46054cb6891eea5).

### Usage

There are three core scripts.

- helpers.R
- lake_report.Rmd
- render_all_lakes.R

In addition to these scripts the csv file `parameters_with_BCWQG_AquaticLife.csv` contains information on which parameters are to be plotted and if applicable what the [BC Water Quality Guidelines](https://www2.gov.bc.ca/gov/content?id=044DD64C7E24415D83D07430964113C9) are.
